question_es: Amazon ___ es el servicio de computación que proporciona instancias de servidor virtual escalables.
question_en: Amazon ___ is the compute service that provides scalable virtual server instances.

question_es: Amazon ___ es el servicio para ejecutar contenedores Docker en AWS sin gestionar la infraestructura subyacente.

question_es: Amazon ___ es el servicio de base de datos relacional administrado que soporta MySQL, PostgreSQL y Oracle.

question_en: Amazon ___ lets you create an isolated private virtual network in AWS with full control over network configuration.

question_es: AWS ___ es el servicio que registra todas las llamadas a API, eventos de usuario y cambios en tu cuenta de AWS.

question_es: El modelo de precios ___ de EC2 permite pagar solo por las horas que usas sin ningún compromiso a largo plazo.
question_en: EC2's ___ pricing model lets you pay only for the hours you use with no long-term commitment.

question_en: EC2's ___ pricing model offers up to 72% discounts in exchange for 1 or 3-year commitments.

question_en: AWS ___ offer consistent discounts with flexible pricing that work across different services and regions.

question_es: AWS ___ es la herramienta para visualizar, entender y analizar tus gastos de AWS con filtros avanzados.

question_es: AWS ___ te permite establecer alertas cuando tu gasto aproximado se acerca a un límite que defines.
question_en: AWS ___ lets you set alerts when your estimated spending approaches a limit you define.

question_en: ___ are custom labels in AWS that let you track and classify costs by project, department, or customer.

question_es: La ___ de AWS ayuda a comparar el costo total de propiedad (TCO) entre sistemas locales y soluciones en la nube.
question_en: AWS's ___ helps compare the total cost of ownership (TCO) between on-premises and cloud solutions.

question_es: AWS ___ utiliza machine learning para detectar automáticamente patrones inusuales o anomalías en tu gasto.
question_en: AWS ___ uses machine learning to automatically detect unusual patterns or anomalies in your spending.

question_es: El plan de soporte ___ es gratuito e incluye acceso a documentación, community forums y checks personalizados limitados.
question_en: The ___ support plan is free and includes documentation access, community forums, and limited checks.

question_en: AWS's ___ support plan provides email response within 24 hours for non-critical cases.

question_en: The ___ support plan includes response time under 1 hour for critical platform problems.
